{{Top|leg}}
'''Toraaso''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Malkite poisoner's kit]], Toraaso relayed information that there appeared to be a power struggle brewing in the ranks of the [[Malkite Ring]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
